prompt: make some creative decisions to turn every other element on the screen into something visually interesting. each should be its own mod.

messages.text: make some creative decisions to turn every other element on the screen into something visually interesting. each should be its own mod.

ran ls sites/timsrobot.com; trif mods | grep timsrobot; trif run 'return [...document.querySelectorAll("main h1, .btn, .hero .small, h2, section.two > div, footer")].map(e=>({tag:e.tagName,cls:e.className,text:e.textContent.trim().slice(0,50)}))'
ran trif screenshot -o before.png
read ~/Library/Application Support/TRIF/screenshots/timsrobot.com/before.png

The tagline and the robot are done, which leaves six things on the page. My plan, one mod each:

- **the title** → a flickering neon sign
- **the two buttons** → jelly that wobbles when you tap it
- **"Free and open source"** → sticker badges
- **What you need** → a checklist you can tick
- **Yours, on your computer** → a little terminal window
- **the footer** → a scrolling LED sign

Starting at the top.
ran trif new timsrobot.com neon && trif new timsrobot.com jelly && trif new timsrobot.com stickers
wrote sites/timsrobot.com/neon.js
wrote sites/timsrobot.com/jelly.js
wrote sites/timsrobot.com/stickers.js

ran trif check timsrobot.com/neon && trif check timsrobot.com/jelly && trif check timsrobot.com/stickers && trif reload && trif errors; trif run 'await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3000)); return {lit:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector("main h1")).animationName, badges:document.querySelectorAll(".sb-badge").length}'
The top half works: the title lights up, the buttons wobble and the stickers pop in. Now the three further down.
ran trif new timsrobot.com checklist && trif new timsrobot.com terminal && trif new timsrobot.com led
wrote sites/timsrobot.com/checklist.js
A mod can't read your disk, so the terminal can't run a real `ls`. It'll list the mods in your side panel for this site instead, so it keeps up as you make more.
wrote sites/timsrobot.com/terminal.js
wrote sites/timsrobot.com/led.js

ran trif check timsrobot.com/checklist && trif check timsrobot.com/terminal && trif check timsrobot.com/led && trif reload && trif errors; for s in "ul[data-nc]" "[data-tb]" footer; do trif run "document.querySelector('$s').scrollIntoView({block:'center'})"; trif screenshot; done
read ~/Library/Application Support/TRIF/screenshots/timsrobot.com/2026-11-03T11-02-17.png
All six run with no errors. The LED dots are too small to read on a phone, so I'm making them bigger.
edited sites/timsrobot.com/led.js
ran trif reload && trif errors; trif run 'document.querySelector("footer").scrollIntoView({block:"center"})'; trif screenshot -o led.png
read ~/Library/Application Support/TRIF/screenshots/timsrobot.com/led.png

Done: six new mods, one for each part of the page.

- **Neon Title:** the title flickers on like a hot-pink neon sign, and a wave rolls through its letters.
- **Jelly Buttons:** tap "Get it" or "GitHub" and the button squashes and wobbles like jelly.
- **Sticker Badges:** "Free and open source" is now three tilted stickers that pop in one after another.
- **Need Checklist:** **What you need** is a checklist. The boxes tick themselves when you scroll to it, and you can tap them to tick or untick.
- **Terminal Box:** **Yours, on your computer** is a little terminal window. It types out `ls ~/.trif/sites/timsrobot.com` and lists the mods we've made.
- **LED Footer:** the footer is an amber LED sign, with its links scrolling past.

**What I checked:** after a reload, all six ran with no errors, and the screenshots of each part look right. If your phone is set to reduce motion, they keep still.

Each one has its own switch in the side panel, so you can turn any of them off.
